rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides SSH remote control capabilities through the Model Context Protocol, enabling secure command execution and file transfer operations on remote servers. Built with TypeScript and leverages the ssh2 library for SSH connectivity, offering session management, SFTP client functionality, and comprehensive validation utilities. Useful for automating server administration tasks, deploying applications, managing remote configurations, or integrating SSH operations into AI-assisted workflows.
